Bill.BriefDescription: Encouraging the use of reclaimed water.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating incentives to encourage the use ofreclaimed water; adding a new section to chapter 90.46 RCW; andrepealing RCW 90.46.130.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a water right holder reclaims any of their wastewater, theamount of water reclaimed must be added to the instantaneous and annualquantities of water right embodied in a permit, certificate, or claimgranted under chapter 90.03 or 90.44 RCW.
RCW 90.46.130 (Impairment of water rightsdownstream from freshwater discharge points) and 2002 c 329 s 5, 2001c 69 s 4, & 1997 c 444 s 4 are each repealed.
